entries.comment: Facts correct; ru человек IPA agrees with en.wiktionary ([t͡ɕɪɫɐˈvʲek], with dark l).

Cognates are real. Note for the pl and ru overlays: Polish żona means only "wife" (en.wiktionary; "woman" is obsolete) and Russian жена likewise, so жінка/żona is a partial false friend that no overlay records.
Palatalized д before і: JIPA vowel table gives дім as dʲim, and dentals contrast palatalized/plain. Consistent with the other edited entries.
pl clue wujek is accepted: en.wiktionary lists both mother's brother and father's brother (stryj) senses.

Stress по́друга follows Hrinchenko 1909, Holoskevych 1929 and en.wiktionary uk (по́друга, IPA [ˈpɔdrʊɦɐ]); older Ukrainian dictionaries and Russian have подру́га, so a learner may meet both. Not an error.

entries.seen: {"title":"The sound of г","body":"A voiced fricative, the voiced partner of х. Phoneticians describe it differently: /ɦ/, glottal, in the published IPA illustration (Pompino-Marschall et al. 2017); [ʕ] before а, о, у, и, е, [ɣʲ] when softened, and [ɣ] before voiced consonants and at the end of a word in Vakulenko 2025, who finds no convincing evidence for glottal [ɦ]. Both agree that it is voiced, which English h is not: Vakulenko finds English h closer to х. The plosive /ɡ/ has its own letter, ґ.","sources":[{"title":"Pompino-Marschall, Steriopolo & Żygis (2017), Ukrainian, Journal of the IPA","url":"https://doi.org/10.1017/S0025100316000372"},{"title":"Vakulenko (2025), Balcania et Slavia 5(1)","url":"https://edizionicafoscari.unive.it/en/edizioni4/riviste/balcania-et-slavia/2025/1/movoznavchi-ta-didaktichni-aspekti-vikhodu-z-ukray/"}]}

{"title":"The variants of в","body":"One phoneme, /ʋ/, with variants by position: labiodental [ʋ] before front vowels, nearer [w] before rounded back vowels, and [u̯] at the end of a syllable, as in був (was, masculine). It does not turn into f. Vakulenko 2025 disputes the label [w], since the lips barely protrude, and writes [β̞].","sources":[{"title":"Pompino-Marschall, Steriopolo & Żygis (2017), Ukrainian, Journal of the IPA","url":"https://doi.org/10.1017/S0025100316000372"},{"title":"Vakulenko (2025), Balcania et Slavia 5(1)","url":"https://edizionicafoscari.unive.it/en/edizioni4/riviste/balcania-et-slavia/2025/1/movoznavchi-ta-didaktichni-aspekti-vikhodu-z-ukray/"}]}

{"title":"The vowel и","body":"Written /ɪ/ here, following the IPA illustration: retracted and lowered compared with і, with a hard consonant before it. Close to the Russian vowel [ɨ], but not the same sound. Vakulenko 2025 transcribes it as a lowered, advanced [ɨ] instead. Without stress it comes close to е.","sources":[{"title":"Pompino-Marschall, Steriopolo & Żygis (2017), Ukrainian, Journal of the IPA","url":"https://doi.org/10.1017/S0025100316000372"},{"title":"Vakulenko (2025), Balcania et Slavia 5(1)","url":"https://edizionicafoscari.unive.it/en/edizioni4/riviste/balcania-et-slavia/2025/1/movoznavchi-ta-didaktichni-aspekti-vikhodu-z-ukray/"}]}

{"title":"о without stress","body":"Written /ɔ/ here, following the IPA illustration. Unlike in Russian, it does not reduce towards a without stress: вода́ is never вада́. It can still shift slightly, towards [o] before a stressed /u/. Vakulenko 2025 describes the vowel as close-mid [o] rather than /ɔ/.","sources":[{"title":"Pompino-Marschall, Steriopolo & Żygis (2017), Ukrainian, Journal of the IPA","url":"https://doi.org/10.1017/S0025100316000372"},{"title":"Vakulenko (2025), Balcania et Slavia 5(1)","url":"https://edizionicafoscari.unive.it/en/edizioni4/riviste/balcania-et-slavia/2025/1/movoznavchi-ta-didaktichni-aspekti-vikhodu-z-ukray/"}]}

{"title":"Dźwięk г","body":"Dźwięczna spółgłoska szczelinowa, para bezdźwięcznego х. Fonetycy opisują ją różnie: /ɦ/, krtaniowa, w opublikowanej ilustracji IPA (Pompino-Marschall et al. 2017); [ʕ] przed а, о, у, и, е, [ɣʲ] w pozycji miękkiej oraz [ɣ] przed spółgłoskami dźwięcznymi i na końcu wyrazu u Wakulenki (2025), który nie znajduje przekonujących dowodów na krtaniowe [ɦ]. Zwartą /ɡ/ oznacza osobna litera ґ.","sources":[{"title":"Pompino-Marschall, Steriopolo & Żygis (2017), Ukrainian, Journal of the IPA","url":"https://doi.org/10.1017/S0025100316000372"},{"title":"Vakulenko (2025), Balcania et Slavia 5(1)","url":"https://edizionicafoscari.unive.it/en/edizioni4/riviste/balcania-et-slavia/2025/1/movoznavchi-ta-didaktichni-aspekti-vikhodu-z-ukray/"}]}

{"title":"Warianty в","body":"Jeden fonem, /ʋ/, z wariantami zależnymi od pozycji: wargowo-zębowe [ʋ] przed samogłoskami przednimi, bliżej [w] przed zaokrąglonymi samogłoskami tylnymi i [u̯] na końcu sylaby, jak w був (był). Nie przechodzi w f. Wakulenko (2025) kwestionuje oznaczenie [w], ponieważ wargi prawie się nie wysuwają, i zapisuje [β̞].","sources":[{"title":"Pompino-Marschall, Steriopolo & Żygis (2017), Ukrainian, Journal of the IPA","url":"https://doi.org/10.1017/S0025100316000372"},{"title":"Vakulenko (2025), Balcania et Slavia 5(1)","url":"https://edizionicafoscari.unive.it/en/edizioni4/riviste/balcania-et-slavia/2025/1/movoznavchi-ta-didaktichni-aspekti-vikhodu-z-ukray/"}]}

{"title":"Samogłoska и","body":"Zapisywana tu jako /ɪ/, jak w ilustracji IPA: bardziej tylna i niższa niż і, z twardą spółgłoską przed nią. Blisko polskiego y, ale to nie ten sam dźwięk. Wakulenko (2025) transkrybuje ją jako obniżone, przesunięte do przodu [ɨ]. Bez akcentu zbliża się do е.","sources":[{"title":"Pompino-Marschall, Steriopolo & Żygis (2017), Ukrainian, Journal of the IPA","url":"https://doi.org/10.1017/S0025100316000372"},{"title":"Vakulenko (2025), Balcania et Slavia 5(1)","url":"https://edizionicafoscari.unive.it/en/edizioni4/riviste/balcania-et-slavia/2025/1/movoznavchi-ta-didaktichni-aspekti-vikhodu-z-ukray/"}]}

{"title":"о bez akcentu","body":"Zapisywane tu jako /ɔ/, jak w ilustracji IPA. Bez akcentu nie redukuje się w stronę a: вода́ to nigdy вада́. Вибуховий /ɡ/ позначає окрема літера ґ.","sources":[{"title":"Pompino-Marschall, Steriopolo & Żygis (2017), Ukrainian, Journal of the IPA","url":"https://doi.org/10.1017/S0025100316000372"},{"title":"Vakulenko (2025), Balcania et Slavia 5(1)","url":"https://edizionicafoscari.unive.it/en/edizioni4/riviste/balcania-et-slavia/2025/1/movoznavchi-ta-didaktichni-aspekti-vikhodu-z-ukray/"}]}
